clusters.name: Wide Balanced Block
clusters.description: Even share of the ball, stretches the pitch with wide play and engages around halfway.

clusters.name: Direct & Physical
clusters.description: Plays long and early, competes for second balls and accepts low pass completion.

clusters.name: Possession & High Press
clusters.description: Dominates the ball with short, secure passing and wins it back high up the pitch.

clusters.name: Counter-Attacking Low Block
clusters.description: Concedes the ball, defends deep and compact, then breaks quickly into space.

clusters.name: Controlled Possession
clusters.description: Patient, narrow build-up; keeps the ball but defends in a mid-block rather than pressing high.

backtest.description: Rolling-origin backtest, Premier League 2015/16. Ratings for each matchday use only earlier matches (xG-based, shrunk toward league average). First half of the predictions tunes the draw adjustment; metrics are on the second half.
